text:
Data Engineer (Strong Middle)
Quillstack · Office in Lviv
Salary range: $3800 – $4800

Quillstack helps European retailers forecast demand. Our data team of 12 runs pipelines over 2 TB of sales data a day.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines in Spark and Airflow
- Model data in Snowflake with dbt
- Keep data quality checks green

Requirements
- 3+ years as a Data Engineer
- Strong Python and SQL
- Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake
- Experience with GCP
- English B2

Benefits
- Modern office in the city center
- Medical insurance
- Learning budget
